title: A new message menu, a tidier chat list and more
intro: Hi there! This update makes BranchChat a little neater everywhere. Here’s what’s new.

items.title: A new message menu
items.text: Press and hold (or tap) a message for a compact menu with your reactions at the top. It always stays on screen.

items.title: A tidier chat list
items.text: Pin chats to the top, drag them into any order and tuck old ones away in Archived Chats. The bottom bar is slimmer, with a + for New group and Add friend.

items.title: Nicer link previews
items.text: Links show a compact preview card, and YouTube videos go full screen in the desktop app.

items.title: Reactions
items.text: Every reaction shows a count, and a + chip adds yours.

items.title: Round profile pictures
items.text: Drag and zoom to pick the perfect circle, or tap Edit photo first.

items.title: Display size
items.text: Scale the whole app from 85% to 130%, next to Text size in the menu.

items.title: Phone menus
items.text: On phones the menu and Profile Settings open full screen with a Back button, and Report a bug is now a row in the menu instead of a floating button.

items.title: GIFs and iPhone alerts
items.text: Picking a GIF closes the picker, and Safari no longer quietly turns off notifications on iPhone and iPad.

items.title: Android
items.text: Message alerts keep working while the phone dozes and after a restart, and you can share photos, videos and files into a chat.

items.title: New BranchChat License 2.0
items.text: Free for individuals, churches, approved nonprofits and small businesses. See License in the footer or menu.

items.title: One version everywhere
items.text: The web, Android, desktop and server apps now share one version number, so update checks agree.
